hero.label: About Us
hero.title: Steady guidance for complex decisions.
hero.subtitle: Founded on the principle that trust is the foundation of effective consulting, Acorn Benefits has served business owners, CFOs, and HR leaders with clarity, integrity, and unwavering advocacy.

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: Acorn Benefits was founded with a simple mission: to bring clarity and confidence to the complex world of employee benefits. After decades of experience on both the carrier and broker sides of the industry, we recognized a gap in the market for consulting that prioritized long-term partnership over transactional relationships.
story.p2: The acorn symbolizes our approach—small, steady investments in trust and expertise that grow into lasting security for your organization. Like the oak tree that grows from humble beginnings, we believe that sound benefits strategy starts with solid foundations and patient cultivation.
story.p3: Today, we serve businesses across the Pacific Northwest and beyond, bringing 60+ years of combined expertise to every client relationship.

items.title: Integrity
items.desc: We provide transparent counsel, disclose all compensation, and place client interests above all else. No hidden agendas, no surprises.

items.title: Expertise
items.desc: Continuous learning keeps us ahead of regulatory changes, market trends, and emerging strategies. We bring deep knowledge to every engagement.

items.title: Partnership
items.desc: We measure success by your outcomes, not our commissions. Our relationships extend for years because we remain present when you need us.
